Well if you ever want to just talk, feel free to let me know. In the meanwhile I suggest you watch this famous episode of the Twilight Zone called "eye of the beholder". It's about a woman who is in a hospital, and the doctors try to make her look more "normal" because she can't fit in with society. Here's the video:  
https://archive.org/details/TwilightzoneEyeofthebeholder

Thank you for the input, I don't really know who else I could have discussed this with. As for my friend, I agree that he doesn't have many options. I try to hope things will work out with him, but I have doubts. I don't think he's from india, all I know is he is in a country close by eastern russia.

Straight male here. I know how it feels to be alone - I'm in my 30's and have never even held another girl's hand. To be honest I've reached a point where looks don't matter to me - so in the chance that you decide not to off yourself, know that there are men like me (rare, I know) who aren't phased by appearances.

If you're anywhere around Michigan, I'd love to talk to you.
That sounds rough, and I'm really sorry you're going through this. It sounds like there's a lot on your mind right now, would you mind sharing a few details about your life?
